title: Some Sci-Fi research + resources
author: esorhizome
selftext:
I recently asked Claude to help me build some research folders so that I can ask better questions + make《what I feel are》prettier results.

●Theme: 

\*\*•Maths,\*\* 

\*\*••Electronic Fashion,\*\* 

\*\*•••Animation,\*\* 

\*\*••••Programmatic Sounds + Visuals\*\*

◇Research obtained with an up-to-date Bibliography.

\# ˖❀TL;DR❀. ݁₊ ⊹⋆𓍢ִ໋˖▪︎◇𖥔 ݁ ˖.⣀｡

r1: programmatic sound + visuals \[sparks&sprites\](https://github.com/esorhizome/sparks-and-sprites)

r2: hand-drawn animation + pixel art \[The Living Line\](https://github.com/esorhizome/the-living-line)

r4: GitBash guidance \[GitBash Field Guide\](https://github.com/esorhizome/git-bash-field-guide)

(\*I say please + thanks so that I don't forget these habits with humans.\*)

\>!⦿NOTE: I personally believe that the term «slop» is applied to creative technology that's built without care/concern,!<

\>!therefore: slop\\\[py\\\].!<



\>!⦿⦿Sooo, if you know more of what can be done...Even if you're asking an agent to help you build, you can provide more specific guidance as to the unique vision you have.!<



\>!《《I think of it like learning to speak to someone.!<

\>!If I all I can say is Hello, I'll never get to know anything about them, nor they me.》》!<



\>! ⦿⦿⦿I think more of this direct-guidance will create better results for hand-coders, hand-designers, as well as those that aren't super smart and use artificial intelligence to help them learn🙌!<

\>!→→→ For Games, for web-art, for assets!<

\>!(♬♬)I've seen some people complain about issues with web-games not displaying properly in their browsers!<

\>!❥ so, perhaps also some troubleshooting strategies on how to optimise for browsers!<

\>!❥❥ ((Is there a way to test for Safari compatibility without having an Apple device?))!<

\>!❥❥❥ Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, Opera, Firefox, Samsung Internet, Brave, DuckDuckGo Browser.!<

\>!(♬♬♬)FOR WHOM?!<

\>!→people with ADHD and‐or severe memory-retention difficulties.!<

\>!→→people who like maths but have some form of dysgraphia!<

\>!→→→people who freeze up due to info-overwhelm when trying to work with code!<

\>!→→→→people who assume that coders are some pedestalised other far away from them.!<

\>!→→→→→people who are self-discouragement prone but also over-the-top-sycophant praise-resistant!<

\>!★ ～☆・t h e r e f o r e: keep praise frequent, but subtle!<

\>!(♬♬♬♬)4 extra things, please:!<



\>!(1)❥ Could you add a section on sound effects deployed programmatically too?!<

\>!(2)❥❥ Could this be made into a public repo with cheatsheets + chapter-sized versions (never assuming knowledge is remembered. Always re-explaining jargon as it‐when it appears). Please commit + push when complete.!<

\>!(3)❥❥❥ Could this contain visual demos (so viewers can directly see, !<

\>!✺e.g. codeX => visualY!<

\>!✺✺here's an example of a resource that "shows" \\\[while\\\] "tell"ing!<

\>!✺✺✺ https://saint11.art/blog/pixel-art-tutorials/!<

\>!(4)❥❥❥❥ Web + Godot given direct demos!<

\>!✺ Unity + Unreal given explanations,!<

\>!✺✺e.g. "And in Unity and Unreal, here's the code that generates a similar result + why. Try it for yourself & tweak settings as you prefer."!<

\>!✺✺✺since it's difficult to demo those without bloating the entire study book)!<

\>!(♬♬♬♬♬)4 final asks, please:!<

\>!❥Can I download Node.js? I want you to execute rather than just review the JavaScript.!<

\>!❥❥Download Godot and directly check the GDScript files too.!<

\>!❥❥❥I feel like three.js & Babylon.js are extremely valuable to learn more about. Can I have a thorough section added to the repo that goes into depth about the various ways it can be used!<

\>!✺3D, 2D, and/or any sort of combination if such a manifestation is possible, please.!<

\>!❥❥❥❥Also an explanation describing the differences-of-use between Node.js, three.js, Babylon.js as well as any necessary dependencies of either.!<
